conversation.text:
Police: From what age did Ms. Shen Huijing start taking care of Xiyuan?
Respondent: It’s been many years. The first time she came was when Xiyuan was four years old.
Respondent: During the time when my wife passed away, I felt like the sky had collapsed. I didn’t know how to take care of the children.
Respondent: Thanks to Huijing, she helped me tremendously.
Respondent: Recently, I think people call it a nanny, right?
Respondent: She was the nanny I hired to help take care of the children.
Respondent: Since my wife began her hospitalization, she came to our home every day to look after the children. The children also liked her very much.
Respondent: After my wife suddenly passed away, it was also because of her that the children were able to get through that difficult time smoothly.
Respondent: Especially Xiyuan—she was very close to Huijing and always called her mom.
Respondent: I am truly very grateful to her—
Respondent: I never expected something like this to happen. It seems I relied on her too much.
Respondent: After all... she is not family...
